name: QiYi M Pro 3x3 V3 Flagship (Magnetic)
description: The QiYi M Pro 3x3 V3 Flagship is a high-value magnetic speed cube that puts professional-level tuning within reach. It carries QiYi's visual dual-adjustment system, classic edge-corner magnetic positioning, and a fine frosted finish that stays calm under the lights and holds up over long practice sessions.
features: Pro performance, real value: A professional speedcubing experience without the flagship price, built around speed and stability.
Dial in your feel: The visual dual-adjustment system lets you set axis distance and elasticity by hand, then read your exact settings at a glance.
Fast, decisive turning: Classic edge-corner magnetic positioning gives every turn a crisp, precise click into place.
Measured improvement: QiYi rates the V3 higher than the V2 across adjustment, smoothness, stability, and corner cutting.
Visual multi-point star system: Turns setup from guesswork into something you can see and repeat.
8-level axis distance: Rotate counterclockwise; the larger the number in the circular hole, the tighter the axis distance.
